title: MSA-OFF
description: MSA-OFF for BMW MGU (iDrive 7 & 8). Permanently disable the automatic start-stop (MSA2) on DDE9 diesels via the car's own diagnostic link. ISTA's exact sequence: 31 01 F5 29 on DDE 0x12, verified by read-back. Arm+confirm safety with tasu-guard (parked check). One-way only: re-enabling stays with ISTA.
